text:
jordan: Quick sync — we need to schedule a 45m design review for the combined API + SDK + Console UX changes for model routing and the new pin/version UI. Goal: finalize API surface and console wireframes so eng can start implementation next sprint. :calendar:

leah: I'm on PTO Tue/Wed, free Mon/Thu afternoon. Prefer Thu if possible. :+1:

sam_sdk: Can do Thu 3-4pm PT. Will need at least 10m to walk SDK surface and an example migration snippet.

mike_ui: Thu works for me too. Will bring the new mockups and a short interactive prototype.

anya_pm: I can join Thu as well. Quick ask: can we make pre-reads available by EOD tomorrow? I want reviewers to have time. :eyes:

jordan: Yes — pre-reads below. Also propose agenda and checklist. If Thu is blocked, alternate slots: Mon 4-5pm PT or Fri 9-10am PT. Please react with :thumbsup: on your preferred slot.

jordan: PRE-READS (link + brief):
- https://internal.redwood.com/docs/prereads/api-sdk-console-routing — API draft + example requests (2 pages)
- https://internal.redwood.com/designs/console/pin-ux-v2 — Console wireframes + clickthrough (Figma link inside)
- https://internal.redwood.com/notes/qa/latency-cost-tradeoffs — perf notes + suggested quantization/batching defaults

jordan: AGENDA (45m):
```
0-5m  — quick context and goals (jordan)
5-20m — API surface + migration path (sam_sdk)
20-35m — Console UX walkthrough + edge cases (mike_ui)
35-40m — rollouts, compatibility, and fallbacks (leah)
40-45m — decisions & next steps (anya)
```

jordan: PRE-READ CHECKLIST (please confirm in-thread):
- Read API draft (pages 1-2) :eyes:
- Run the SDK snippet locally (optional) or skim for breaking changes
- Open console wireframes and note any accessibility concerns
- Add any blocking questions to the doc under "Reviewer Questions" section

leah: Confirmed — I'll add rollout constraints and a short note about canary sizing to the doc by EOD.

sam_sdk: I'll paste a minimal migration example here for reviewers to try: 
```
// JS SDK snippet
const client = new Redwood({ model: 'rwd-model-v2', routing: { prefer_local: true } });
const res = await client.generate({ prompt: 'Summarize...' });
console.log(res.text);
```

mike_ui: Adding keyboard nav notes to the Figma comments. Also flagging a potential overflow case for long model names.

anya_pm: TAGGING REVIEWERS: @leah, @sam_sdk, @mike_ui — assign primary reviewers. If anyone else should be cc'd (infra, security), add them now.

leah: cc'ing infra: @ci-bot (for routing policy tests) and @ops-liz (for Dedicated capacity considerations).

ci-bot: deploy-checklist reminder — please ensure any API breaking changes have a migration guide and migration tests. See https://internal.redwood.com/infra/deploy-checks

jordan: Excellent. Tally reactions and we'll lock Thu 3-3:45pm PT if most thumbs up. If Thu gets majority, I'll send calendar invite and attach the doc links + Figma.

sam_sdk: :thumbsup: for Thu 3pm

mike_ui: :thumbsup:

leah: :thumbsup:

anya_pm: :thumbsup:

jordan: Locked — Thu 1937693520 (3:00pm PT) scheduled. I'll follow up with the meeting invite and put a short pre-review at the top of the doc summarizing open questions. Thanks all! :tada:
